_about: The Rulebook’s scope engine, as data. Each rule cites the paragraph it comes from; src/lib/lab/scope.ts evaluates them. The sector lists come from NIS2 Annexes I and II (CER Annex sectors flagged). Question wording and the six golden cases await Swann’s approval.
